speech.heard: Only 47 of 208 countries and territories see babies expected to live past 80. Yellow shows 80 plus years, while dark blue is under 80. Life expectancy indicates the number of years a newborn would live if mortality patterns stay the same. Japan hits 84 years, while Switzerland also reaches 84 years. India is at 72 years, and the USA is at 79 years. Nigeria sits at 55 years, the world's lowest among these countries. So where does your country fall on this map?
